name: Mori Kara Kita my Tomo
source:
"There are actions that we do and regret and there are memories that we will never forget until the day we grow old. Learn of Takao's childhood experience through this short visual novel."

Based on the story of a young boy who has learned a special lesson in life that will change him forever. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191017090449/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=maitomo.playhaus]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
“我们会做出某些行为并为之懊悔，也会有些记忆伴随我们直到老去。通过这部短篇视觉小说，了解隆夫的童年经历吧。”

故事讲述一个年幼的男孩学到人生中特别的一课，这一课将永远改变他。

[来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191017090449/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=maitomo.playhaus]Google Play[/url]]
